name: wall_right
note: 18 mm birch rectangle, 639 high, 589 long on the slant; both ends bevelled 9.0 deg, long edges square (they butt under the top and over the bottom)

name: wall_left
note: 18 mm birch rectangle, 639 high, 589 long on the slant; both ends bevelled 9.0 deg, long edges square (they butt under the top and over the bottom)

name: top
note: 18 mm birch, flat, trapezoid 491 to 675 mm over 582 mm; square edges (the side walls' outer faces run on from them)

name: bottom
note: 18 mm birch, flat, trapezoid 491 to 675 mm over 582 mm; square edges (the side walls' outer faces run on from them)

name: wedge_top
note: tapered wedge under the top: 18 mm sloping panel at the half angle (its face is the horn wall), 18 mm side closures against the side walls and 3 ribs, glued to the flat panel and the baffle front face and sealed; 159 mm deep at the baffle, nothing at the mouth

name: wedge_bottom
note: tapered wedge over the bottom: 18 mm sloping panel at the half angle (its face is the horn wall), 18 mm side closures against the side walls and 3 ribs, glued to the flat panel and the baffle front face and sealed; 159 mm deep at the baffle, nothing at the mouth

name: baffle
note: 25 mm birch rectangle, 480 wide at the front face by 639 high, side edges bevelled 9.0 deg, 353 mm cutout, 8 flange holes on 369 PCD, 4 standoff bolts (one 12 mm duct hole)

name: back
note: 18 mm birch rectangle, removable, 491 x 675 at the front face, side edges bevelled 9.0 deg to continue the walls; 2 mm deep gasket groove; 12 M5 screws into inserts in the wall, top and bottom ends; 64 mm terminal cup

name: filler_tr
note: corner filler: right-angle triangle, 141 mm legs at the baffle to nothing at the mouth, in the corner of a side wall and a wedge face; hardwood or 18 mm ply laminations; slot for the vane

name: filler_tl
note: corner filler: right-angle triangle, 141 mm legs at the baffle to nothing at the mouth, in the corner of a side wall and a wedge face; hardwood or 18 mm ply laminations; slot for the vane

name: filler_bl
note: corner filler: right-angle triangle, 141 mm legs at the baffle to nothing at the mouth, in the corner of a side wall and a wedge face; hardwood or 18 mm ply laminations; slot for the vane

name: filler_br
note: corner filler: right-angle triangle, 141 mm legs at the baffle to nothing at the mouth, in the corner of a side wall and a wedge face; hardwood or 18 mm ply laminations; slot for the vane

name: standoff_duct
note: 20 mm aluminium round, 91 long, M8 into the baffle, 25 mm into the shroud; 12 mm bore: cable duct from the chamber to the centre body

name: standoff_2
note: 20 mm aluminium round, 91 long, M8 into the baffle, 25 mm into the shroud

name: standoff_3
note: 20 mm aluminium round, 91 long, M8 into the baffle, 25 mm into the shroud

name: bullet_nose
note: bullet nose: follows the mid cone at the gap; closes the HF cavity; 3 mm spigot; 3 mm recess for the felt

name: felt
note: 3 mm wool felt on the bullet nose underside, set into a recess so its face is at the designed gap from the mid cone (MidHorn.felt_loss models its damping)

name: bullet
note: bullet round the B&C DE111 body cylinder, outside sized from slices of the mid horn; printed 25 deg OS waveguide 25.0 to 141 mm over 149 mm, the bullet following its outside; 3 mm HF cable bore from the vane back to the HF cavity

name: bullet_vanes
note: three 4 mm vanes hold the bullet in the mid horn, 49 to 81 mm past the throat; one carries the HF cable in a 3 mm bore

name: kick_shroud
note: shroud over the kick cone (sized from cylinder slices), lip, standoff sockets, the kick motor cover and the sealed wall at the motor front; 6 mm shell with radial rib frames every 45 deg; 8 M5 inserts in bosses under the wall

name: mid_chamber_rear
note: rear chamber of the mid (39.5 L in all): 6 mm outer skin, 6 mm mid horn wall, radial rib frames every 45 deg; mid driver mounting ring and lead-in ring over the mid cone (8 inserts for the driver screws); bottom flange bolts to the motor wall (8 M5); glued flange joint at z = 334

name: mid_chamber_front
note: rear chamber of the mid (39.5 L in all): 6 mm outer skin, 6 mm mid horn wall, radial rib frames every 45 deg; mid horn to the mouth, flush with the kick mouth, 4.1 mm rounded edge
